currentContext.expansion: The single expansion programme in this annual report is the Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil manufacturing project. During FY2025-26 Crestchem incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited, Bengaluru, on 31 March 2026 to implement it; the Board's report states an equity participation of 75%, while the secretarial audit report describes the same entity as a Wholly Owned Subsidiary. The subsidiary's registered office is at B-61/A, 2nd Cross, 3rd Stage, Peenya Small Industries, Bangalore North, Karnataka - 560058. The procurement, purchase and installation of plant and machinery, utilities and other manufacturing equipment is presently underway; management states the project is progressing in accordance with the implementation schedule. Subject to timely completion of installation, successful commissioning, statutory approvals and trial production, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of FY2026-27. On commissioning the subsidiary proposes to serve both domestic and international markets, with emphasis on pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and personal care industries, and the Board expects the project to diversify the business portfolio and strengthen long-term growth prospects. Beyond this project the Company states a general intent to expand manufacturing capacity, develop high-purity specialty MCT grades and invest in research and development. No plant capacity, no project cost, no rupee capex quantum and no funding plan is disclosed anywhere in the routed text, and the Directors' report separately states there were no material changes or commitments affecting the financial position of the Company during the year.
